name: singlet_cell_calling_multiome_cell_calling
title: Multiome nucleus calling (joint RNA and ATAC)
description: Calls which barcodes in a single-nucleus RNA plus ATAC multiome run contain a nucleus rather than only ambient background. The default, emptydrops_multiome, tests each barcode against per-modality ambient profiles and writes a joint FDR with RNA and ATAC FDRs. It needs the RNA and ATAC layers over the same unfiltered barcodes. Use emptydrops_rna only without an ATAC layer; do not use this tool for RNA-only libraries.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: emptydrops_multiome: joint RNA and ATAC test; emptydrops_rna: RNA-only test, ATAC not read.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

fdr_threshold.description: Barcodes with FDR at or below this value are called nuclei.

rna_layer.description: RNA UMI layer to read; all barcodes, unfiltered, must be present.

atac_layer.description: ATAC barcode-by-peak count layer; required only by emptydrops_multiome.

seed.description: Random seed for Monte Carlo null draws.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

lower_rna.description: RNA total at or below which barcodes define the RNA ambient profile; null selects automatically.

lower_atac.description: ATAC total at or below which barcodes define the ATAC ambient profile; null selects automatically.

niter_rna.description: Monte Carlo draws for RNA p-values; p resolution is 1/(niter+1).

niter_atac.description: Monte Carlo draws for ATAC p-values; p resolution is 1/(niter+1).

lower.description: RNA total at or below which barcodes define the ambient profile.

alpha.description: inf: multinomial null; estimate: Dirichlet-multinomial scale fitted by maximum likelihood.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Keys: method, fdr_threshold, n_barcodes, n_called, lower_rna_used, lower_atac_used, niter_rna, niter_atac, seed. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
